art_direction: 银辉晴风：回到银白短狼尾与紫晶眼睛方向，以柔和鹅蛋脸、圆顺下颌、轻盈肩线、宝蓝薄夹克及白T恤塑造漂亮而英气的成年女性，电青天空、玫红墙面、柠檬黄栏杆形成高饱和撞色。
composition_variation: Eye-level near-frontal head-to-upper-thigh portrait, slight head tilt, one hand gently lifting jacket collar and the other in trouser pocket, airy hair and lighter shoulder silhouette.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved outside the repository in Codex task artifact directory jewel-silver-cyan-revision/native. Canonical wallpaper is cropped and resized.

wallpaper.hair: Soft pearl-white short wolf cut with blue-violet shadows and fine neck wisps
wallpaper.title: 银辉晴风 · 电青玫红
wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Inspected compressed 589x1280 JPEG. One adult original woman, soft silver-white layered wolf cut, clear violet eyes, gentler oval face and lively slight smile. Coherent hand at collar and other hand in trouser pocket; opaque cobalt jacket, full white shirt and dark trousers. Saturated cyan sky, pink wall, orange lining and yellow fasteners. No visible pseudo-text, watermark, additional people or evident anatomy defects.

visible_description: 银白蓬松短狼尾女性微微偏头浅笑，紫晶眼睛与柔和鹅蛋脸清晰可见；一手轻提宝蓝夹克领边、一手插袋，电青天空和玫红墙面衬着橘黄细节。
